newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU seen clearing 20 bln francs in aid to GAN.
newsitem.headline: EU seen clearing 20 bln francs in aid to GAN.

text.p: BRUSSELS, July 28 (reuter) - The European Commission will clear on Wednesday state aid of 20 billion francs to French insurance company GAN, a European Union source said on Monday.
The previous French conservative government had promised the European Commission that GAN would be privatised in exchange for the Commission's approval of the aid package.
France's new Socialist-led government earlier this month also said it plans to privatise GAN, referring to commitments made to Brussels.
